# Cncf Connect Rpc Reviewer

Review Connect RPC using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / Remote Procedure Call category. Connect is a family of libraries for building browser and gRPC-compatible HTTP APIs.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
